Name: Avoid Losing Scepter
Author: Atravita
TagLine: Prevents loss of the return scepter on death. Also, by popular request, prevent loss of the horse flute or the golden scythe.
Description:
THIS IS A LEGACY MOD, for STARDEW 1.5.6 ONLY. STARDEW 1.6 HAS FIXED THE ISSUE. THANKS!

This mod prevents you from losing the return scepter on death. Also prevents loss of the horse flute or the golden scythe

Install

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Download and install [AtraCore](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

4.  Run the game using SMAPI.
Uninstall
Simply remove this mod from your Mods folder.

Compatibility

*   Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.

*   Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. Should be fine if installed for one player only in multiplayer.

*   Should be compatible with most other mods. (Special handling for [Moon Misadventures](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10612), which has its own way of preventing you from losing certain things on death.)

For other mod authors: if you would like this mod to forbid the loss of an item, just attach the context tag `` on that item.

**See also**

*   [Changelog](https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/AvoidLosingScepter/AvoidLosingScepter/docs/Changelog.md)

*   [Source code](https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/AvoidLosingScepter/AvoidLosingScepter)
Requires SMAPI, uses Harmony.

All donation points for this mod go to [Against Malaria](https://www.againstmalaria.com/). Please consider supporting them if you like this mod!
